technology_name: STEEL FIBRE REINFORCED CONCRETE CRASH BARRIERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional roadside concrete crash barriers suffer from catastrophic structural cracking and fragment during vehicle impacts, failing to absorb structural energy safely.
description: An optimized concrete crash barrier composition reinforced with structurally engineered steel fibers and pre-treated crumb rubber modifiers to provide an enhanced energy absorption profile (Impact Strength) over 3.25 times higher than standard configurations.
applications: High-speed expressways, bridge deck containment barriers, urban median dividers, and hazardous zone security perimeter walls.
